_comment: Rewrites Italian lessons 2-9 (it-people..it-negation) into their assigned archetypes (F,B,C,E,D,A,F,C) from scripts/content/lessons/ITALIAN-VARIETY.md. Italian is schemaVersion 2, where a lesson holds `steps` (each naming a TOP-LEVEL activity) AND `legacyExercises`; both are reordered so step i and legacy exercise i stay the same exercise, and each step's nextStepId is re-chained to follow the new array order because lesson-session.ts advances via nextStepId. The intro (information/notice) stays first and remains entryStepId. The archetype tables name eight non-intro slots only for archetype A; B-F omit `review`. Every lesson here has nine steps (intro + meet,meaning,order,cloze,produce,read,review,listen-model), so in B-F `review` is kept and placed immediately before `listen` -- the position review holds in archetype A and the same adjustment the French payload made. No step, exercise, activity or id is added or removed; order and purpose only. Purposes: notice for the intro, practice for every graded step (no lesson in this range carries a transfer step). Applied centrally by scripts/content/differentiate-first-words.py; not run here.

legacyExercises.prompt: Which Italian word means “are (with tu)”?
legacyExercises.explanation: Tu means you (one familiar person); lui and lei mean he and she. Essere changes: io sono, tu sei, lui/lei è. Use the accent on è (is): e without the accent means and.

legacyExercises.prompt: Which Italian word means “I study”?
